description: Top Power TP4056-42-ESOP8 — single-cell Li-ion/LiPo linear charger IC with constant-current/constant-voltage profile and thermal shutdown. 4.2 V termination, charge current set by PROG resistor (1.2 V / I_charge). The default cheap-and-cheerful maker LiPo charger.
name: tp4056
watch_out_for: ESOP-8 thermal pad MUST be soldered to a copper pour for the rated charge current — uncovered, it derates hard at >300 mA. Rprog = 1200 / I_charge_mA (kΩ); e.g. 1.2 kΩ → 1 A. No battery-protection circuitry inside — pair with a separate DW01-class IC + FET for OV/UV/OC protection on the cell.
